mapper.select: SELECT wbwr.id, wbwr.quantity in_quantity, wbwr.quantity - wbwr.package_quantity - wbwr.cargo_quantity + a.quantity un_package_quantity, a.quantity package_quantity, a.product_id, workshop.id 'workshopInf.id', workshop.name 'workshopInf.name', workshop.id 'workshop.id', workshop.name 'workshop.name', a.id AS linkId, b.name, b.serial_number, b.specification, b.length, b.material, b.quantity, b.net_weight, b.total_net_weight, b.gross_weight, b.total_gross_weight, b.coding_type, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', mbf.`id` 'factory.id', mbf.`name` 'factory.name', wbwr.warehouse_type FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a LEFT JOIN tech_artifact b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON b.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON b.area_id = pd.id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary wbwr ON a.warehouse_record_id = wbwr.id AND wbwr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON wbwr.factory_id = mbf.id AND mbf.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON wbwr.workshop_id = workshop.id AND workshop.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.cargo_list_id = #{cargoListId} and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} and a.package_id is null and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT wbwr.id, wbwr.quantity in_quantity, wbwr.quantity - wbwr.package_quantity - wbwr.cargo_quantity + a.quantity un_package_quantity, a.quantity package_quantity, a.product_id, b.category, b.name, b.serial_number, b.plate, b.color, b.material, b.weight, b.thickness, b.width, b.length, b.quantity, b.total_length, b.total_area, b.brand, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', plan.`id` 'area.id', plan.`name` 'area.name', mbf.`id` 'factory.id', mbf.`name` 'factory.name' FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN enclosure_plan plan ON plan.id = b.enclosure_plan_id AND plan.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary wbwr ON a.warehouse_record_id = wbwr.id AND wbwr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON wbwr.factory_id = mbf.id AND mbf.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.cargo_list_id = #{cargoListId} and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ENCLOSURE.getType()} and a.package_id is null and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT wbwr.id, wbwr.quantity in_quantity, wbwr.quantity - wbwr.package_quantity - wbwr.cargo_quantity + a.quantity un_package_quantity, a.quantity package_quantity, a.product_id, b.serial_number, b.specification, b.measure_unit, b.quantity, b.measure_precision, b.accounting_unit, b.mete, b.accounting_precision, b.color, b.brand, b.remark, b.user_id, b.classify_full_name, b.classify_id, b.classify_name, b.use_property, b.business_id, b.print_quantity, b.print_time, b.unit_net, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name' FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a LEFT JOIN tech_auxiliary_material b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON b.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary wbwr ON a.warehouse_record_id = wbwr.id AND wbwr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.cargo_list_id = #{cargoListId} and a.product_type = 8 and a.package_id is null and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT a.quantity ship_quantity, summary.warehouse_type, a.id AS linkId, a.product_id AS cargoProductId, a.product_type, a.net_weight, a.gross_weight, a.net_weight * a.quantity total_net_weight, a.gross_weight * a.quantity total_gross_weight, a.weight * a.quantity total_weight, a.weight, b.length * a.quantity total_length, a.warehouse_record_id, a.package_id, b.name, b.serial_number, b.specification, b.length, b.material, b.quantity, b.bool_all_part_send_directly, ba.unit_price unit_price, ba.pricing_manner, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', workshop.id AS 'workshop.id', workshop.name AS 'workshop.name', workshop.name AS workshopName, pack.serial_number AS packSerialNumber FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a LEFT JOIN tech_artifact b ON a.product_id = b.id LEFT JOIN business_artifact ba on ba.id = b.business_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON b.monomer_id = pm.id LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON b.area_id = pd.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary summary on summary.id = a.warehouse_record_id and summary.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop on workshop.id = summary.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_package pack on pack.id = a.package_id and pack.bool_delete_enum =0 where a.cargo_list_id = #{cargoListId} and b.bool_all_part_send_directly = 0 and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT link.product_id AS artifactId, business.id, sum(link.quantity ) AS quantity, sum(link.quantity * part.net_weight) AS totalWeight, sum(link.quantity * part.length) AS totalLength, sum(part.net_weight) AS weight, sum(part.length) AS length, part.specification, part.material, business.unit_price AS unit_price, business.pricing_manner, ANY_VALUE(link.warehouse_type) AS warehouseType from mes_building_cargo_list_product_link link LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part part on part .id = link.product_id and part.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIn business_machine_part business on part.business_id = business.id and business.bool_delete_enum = 0 where link.cargo_list_id = #{cargoListId} and link.product_type = 1 and part.bool_all_part_send_directly = 1 and link.bool_delete_enum = FALSE GROUP BY part.specification, part.material,business.id,link.product_id union all SELECT link.product_id AS artifactId, business.id, sum(link.quantity ) AS quantity, sum(link.quantity * ass.net_weight) AS totalWeight, sum(link.quantity * ass.length) AS totalLength, sum(ass.net_weight) AS weight, sum(ass.length) AS length, ass.specification, ass.material, ifnull(business.unit_price, 0) AS unit_price, business.pricing_manner, ANY_VALUE(link.warehouse_type) AS warehouseType from mes_building_cargo_list_product_link link LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ass on ass .id = link.product_id and ass.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIn business_machine_part business on ass.business_id = business.id and business.bool_delete_enum = 0 where link.cargo_list_id = #{cargoListId} and link.product_type = 16 and link.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and ass.bool_all_part_send_directly = 1 GROUP BY ass.specification, ass.material,business.id,link.product_id

SELECT a.quantity shipQuantity, a.length, a.surface_area, a.length * a.quantity total_length, a.surface_area * a.quantity total_area, a.product_id AS cargoProductId, a.product_type, a.warehouse_record_id, a.package_id, a.id AS linkId, b.category, b.name, b.serial_number, b.plate, b.color, b.material, b.weight, b.thickness, b.width, b.unfolded_width unfoldedWidth, b.quantity, b.brand, ifnull(ba.unit_price, 0) unit_price, ba.pricing_manner, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', workshop.id AS 'workshop.id', workshop.name AS 'workshop.name', workshop.name AS workshopName, summary.warehouse_type AS warehouseType, workshop.name AS workshopName, pack.serial_number AS packSerialNumber FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure b ON a.product_id = b.id LEFT JOIN business_enclosure ba ON ba.id = b.business_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON b.area_id = pd.id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary summary on summary.id = a.warehouse_record_id and summary.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ENCLOSURE.getType()} LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop on workshop.id = summary.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_package pack on pack.id = a.package_id and pack.bool_delete_enum =0 where a.cargo_list_id = #{cargoListId} and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ENCLOSURE.getType()} and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT a.quantity shipQuantity, CASE b.bool_weight_type_enum WHEN 1 THEN a.weight * a.quantity ELSE CONVERT(IFNULL(b.mete, 0) / b.quantity, DECIMAL(18,4)) * a.quantity END shipMete, a.product_id AS cargoProductId, a.product_type, a.warehouse_record_id, a.package_id, a.id AS linkId, b.name, b.serial_number, b.specification 'specification', b.quantity, b.measure_unit, IFNULL(b.mete, 0) mete, b.accounting_unit, b.bool_weight_type_enum, ba.unit_price unit_price, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', pack.serial_number AS packSerialNumber, pd.`name` 'area.name', a.warehouse_type AS warehouseType FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a LEFT JOIN tech_standard_part b ON a.product_id = b.id LEFT JOIN business_standard_part ba ON ba.id = b.business_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON b.monomer_id = pm.id LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON b.area_id = pd.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_package pack on pack.id = a.package_id and pack.bool_delete_enum =0 where a.cargo_list_id = #{cargoListId} and a.product_type = 8 and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT a.weight * a.quantity total_weight, a.net_weight * a.quantity total_net_weight, a.gross_weight * a.quantity total_gross_weight, b.length * a.quantity total_length, ifnull(ba.unit_price, 0) unit_price, ba.pricing_manner, a.warehouse_type warehouseType FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a INNER JOIN mes_building_cargo_list l on l.id = a.cargo_list_id LEFT JOIN tech_artifact b ON a.product_id = b.id LEFT JOIN business_artifact ba on ba.id = b.business_id where l.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} and l.status in (4,8) and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT business.id, sum(link.quantity * partDetail.quantity) AS quantity, sum(link.quantity * partDetail.quantity * part.net_weight) AS toTalWeight, sum(link.quantity * partDetail.quantity * part.length) AS toTallLength, part.specification, part.material, ifnull(business.unit_price, 0) unit_price, business.pricing_manner, ANY_VALUE(link.warehouse_type) warehouseType from mes_building_cargo_list_product_link link INNER JOIN mes_building_cargo_list l on l.id = link.cargo_list_id INNER JOIN tech_artifact artifact on artifact.id = link.product_id and artifact.bool_all_part_send_directly = 1 and artifact.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact_machine_part_link partDetail on partDetail.artifact_id = artifact.id and partDetail.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part part on part .id = partDetail.machine_part_id and part.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN business_machine_part business on part.business_id = business.id where l.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} and l.status in (4,8) and link.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} and link.bool_delete_enum = FALSE GROUP BY part.specification, part.material,business.id

SELECT a.length * a.quantity total_length, a.surface_area * a.quantity total_area, ifnull(ba.unit_price, 0) unit_price, a.warehouse_type warehouseType FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a INNER JOIN mes_building_cargo_list l on l.id = a.cargo_list_id LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure b ON a.product_id = b.id LEFT JOIN business_enclosure ba ON ba.id = b.business_id where l.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} and l.status > 3 and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ENCLOSURE.getType()} and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT ifnull(a.quantity, 0) ship_quantity, ifnull( b.quantity, 0) quantity, ifnull(ba.unit_price, 0) unit_price, a.warehouse_type warehouseType FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link a INNER JOIN mes_building_cargo_list l on l.id = a.cargo_list_id LEFT JOIN tech_standard_part b ON a.product_id = b.id LEFT JOIN business_standard_part ba ON ba.id = b.business_id where l.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} and l.status > 3 and a.product_type = 8 and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

and cl.status > 2 and cl.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cl.shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} and clpl.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ENCLOSURE.getType()}

select p.id 'project.id', p.name 'project.name', p.short_name 'project.short_name', p.serial_number 'project.serial_number', temp.quantity, temp.mete from contract_project p
inner join ( select a.project_id, sum(r.quantity) quantity, sum(r.quantity * a.net_weight) mete from mes_building_cargo_list_product_link r inner join mes_building_cargo_list cl on cl.id = r.cargo_list_id inner join tech_artifact a on a.id = r.product_id and r.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} where r.bool_delete_enum = 0 and cl.status > 2 and cl.bool_delete_enum = 0
and date(cl.audit_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(cl.audit_time) <= date(#{endDate})
group by a.project_id) temp on temp.project_id = p.id
inner join ( select a.project_id, sum(r.quantity) quantity, sum(r.quantity * a.length) mete from mes_building_cargo_list_product_link r inner join mes_building_cargo_list cl on cl.id = r.cargo_list_id inner join tech_enclosure a on a.id = r.product_id and r.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ENCLOSURE.getType()} where r.bool_delete_enum = 0 and cl.status > 2 and cl.bool_delete_enum = 0
and date(cl.audit_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(cl.audit_time) <= date(#{endDate})
